title: Sherman's sine wave tone training

tellings.quote: And he said, "I'm going to play a tone, and I want you to mentally hum that tone."

plain: Dan Sherman, who says he was trained by the government to receive messages from alien beings by thought alone, describes a training method from the early 1990s based on pure sine wave tones. A trainer told him, "I'm going to play a tone, and I want you to mentally hum that tone." Sherman tells Michels this happened to him, and if true it would mean official programmes were trying to teach people mental communication.
